heading: 参考资料

sources.title: Introduction
supports: 任务数据通过producer写入topic/分区，消费者读取后由应用处理。
消费记录不删除日志，业务是否完成由应用另行维护。

verification.method: Fresh fixed-source HTTPS GET; relevant executing client/Broker statements read in addition to official documentation. No runtime experiment claimed.

quotation.text: Events in a topic can be read as often as needed-unlike traditional messaging systems, events are not deleted after consumption.

sources.title: Design
supports: 消费者主动按分区位置发起fetch。
存储、读取位置与应用业务完成分开；主机制经本轮实际producer/Broker/consumer执行代码交叉核对。

quotation.text: The Kafka consumer works by issuing "fetch" requests to the brokers leading the partitions it wants to consume.
